title: fix(claude-cli): nested task answers are lost when snapshots list children first
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: Claude CLI turns lose nested subagent or workflow answers when a `background_tasks_changed` snapshot lists a child before its parent.

## User Impact

Replies from nested Agent and Workflow tasks reach the user at any depth and in any snapshot order, instead of the turn ending after the root's answer. The warm session stays reusable afterward.

## Why This Change Was Made

Main evaluated holds in one pass over the snapshot, so a child seen before its parent found no held parent and was skipped. Hold acquisition is now a fixed-point scan in `cli-runtime-tasks.ts`: ownership is recorded for the whole snapshot first, then each productive pass adds at least one hold, so cycles without a held ancestor terminate. The input, subagent-owned, task-type, and held-parent gates are unchanged.

Forward-port of `8bf0e03aa413` from `release/2026.11.1`, adapted to main's code. Main's scan was a single pass, not the release's two-pass one, so this also fixes two-level child-first snapshots. The logic moved next to `recordTaskOwnership` to stay inside the `cli.runtime.ts` line cap.

Deliberate difference: the release also gates on `session.notifiedTasks`, which main does not have. Main already holds a re-listed root task with no such gate. Adding that set is a separate behavior change, so this PR does not port it, and it does not port the release's `notified` test case. A task re-listed after its notification could therefore gain a hold; that gap already exists on main for roots.

## Evidence

- Reproduced on `origin/main` first with a new native-stdio regression: 8 of 9 cases failed, for example `expected [ 'waiting', 'level-0 reply' ] to deeply equal [ 'waiting', 'level-0 reply', ...(1) ]`.
- With the fix, `pnpm test extensions/anthropic/cli-runtime.nested-tasks.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 9 passed, about 3.8s of test time (77s wall including transform on a cold cache). CI seconds to follow from the PR run.
- The sibling suites `cli-runtime.test.ts`, `cli-runtime.task-ownership.test.ts`, and `cli-runtime.yield.test.ts` pass.
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions`, `pnpm tsgo:extensions:test`, `run-oxlint`, `oxfmt --check`, and `check:line-cap-ratchet` pass.
- Net test growth of 154 lines is recorded in `config/test-lines-allocations/claude-cli-deep-descendant-holds.txt`. No existing file covered snapshot ordering, and the cases are a trimmed subset of the release's 34.
- Not run: a real Claude CLI. The fixture speaks the native stdio protocol.
- Unresolved CI: `checks-node-changed-compact-large-2` fails twice on this head (original run and one single-job rerun) in the Bun shard `agentic-gateway-server-isolated-hosted-1`: `src/gateway/server.chat-cli-auth.test.ts` reports one extra Claude CLI launch after credential revocation at line 364 (`expected 8 to be 7`, then `expected 9 to be 8`). It passes 4 of 4 locally on Node on this branch. Its test file contains no `background_tasks_changed`, the only message this PR changes. Main's regular CI does not run this Bun shard, so its green does not prove this is inherited, and a base-vs-head run on the pinned Bun build has not been done. Treat as unproven until that comparison exists.


## Inherited failure

`checks-node-changed-compact-large-2` fails on `src/gateway/server.chat-cli-auth.test.ts:364` (`expected 9 to be 8`). This is not caused by this PR: the same test fails with the same assertion on `main`'s scheduled Bun CI at `46943d587a` without this change ([run 42018871974](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/42018871974), job 127216528215). It needs its own fix, since it asserts no CLI launch after credential revocation on the Bun runtime.
